Theme

School & learning

research noun and verb

also investigation, do research, look into

classical

Cic. Off. 1.13: vērī inquīsītiō atque investīgātiō
Traupman 31, 370
M-O s.v. research (scientific)

investīgātiō, investīgātiōnis f.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

research, investigation

Other words

  • investīgō, investīgāre, investīgāvī, investīgātum — to research, to track down

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Ter. Haut. 675; Traupman 31, 370 · Conjugation on Wiktionary

    Properly to follow a track, as a hound does (ad investīgandum sagācitās nārium, Cic. ND 2.158, Lewis & Short).

  • indāgātiō, indāgātiōnis f. — a searching out, an inquiry

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.15: indāgātiō atque inventiō vērī (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. research (scientific) · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • in prīmīsque hominis est propria vērī inquīsītiō atque investīgātiō

    above all, it is proper to man to search for the truth and to research itCic. Off. 1.13

  • Nihil tam difficile est quīn quaerendō investīgārī possiet.

    Nothing is so hard that it can’t be found out by looking.Ter. Haut. 675

See also student, history.
